A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way.","room":"Phrase: 'A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way' — two readings weighed: applying whenever the judge uses a verse as support for breaking the link, or applying only if the judge expressly labels the verse an unanswered witness.","why":"The judge uses Matthew 1:18 and 1:25 to break C3 but names no earlier round and quotes no sentence pressing them against that link, so it breaches K-G4."}
